bundle.shortDescription: Network operations, with subscribers and billing.
bundle.longDescription: Nocturne ISP: everything in Nocturne — terminal, discovery, monitoring, configuration backup and compliance, safe configuration changes, automation, topology, IPAM, a virtual lab and an AI assistant — plus the subscriber ledger: customers, tariffs priced per megabit, subscriptions, invoices, payments, credit notes, arrears ageing, and what each megabit earned against what it cost.
